textRuns.value: Executive Summary: This report is designed to answer four core questions: (1) How much did we spend versus estimated Pay-As-You-Go retail equivalent? (2) Which services, regions, and meters drive variance and directional savings? (3) Where are retail-match gaps and data quality issues limiting confidence? (4) Is the ingestion and enrichment pipeline healthy and complete across MTD and last-month snapshots? Use the navigation section to move through overview, validation, diagnostics, retail reference, and technical model pages. Drillthrough pages remain intentionally hidden from standard navigation.
